* **Executable Logic**:
  * [`first_difference`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/compare.rs#L94-L138): Pure, lazy, deterministic borrowed inspection returning on the earliest mismatch in order:
    1. `left.identity.profile != right.identity.profile` $\rightarrow$ `Identity(IdentityField::Profile)`
    2. `left.identity.source_sha256 != right.identity.source_sha256` $\rightarrow$ `Identity(IdentityField::SourceSha256)`
    3. [`snapshot_difference`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/compare.rs#L140-L159) on `initial` $\rightarrow$ `Initial(field)`
    4. `left.records.iter().zip(right.records).enumerate()` in ascending index order: `rule_start_line`, `charge`, `before` snapshot, `after` snapshot $\rightarrow$ `Record { index, field }`
    5. `left.records.len() != right.records.len()` $\rightarrow$ `Length { common_records, left_records, right_records }`
    6. `None` if all compared fields and record lengths match.
  * [`snapshot_difference`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/compare.rs#L140-L159): Pure helper comparing [`Snapshot`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/reference_types.rs#L156-L165) fields by value in exact [`SnapshotField`](file:///home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/compare.rs#L47-L56) order (`program.as_ref()`, `control`, `environment`, `frames`, `stack_limit`, `remaining_fuel`, `initial_fuel`, `outcome`).
